group.passage: Breakfast in Taiwan is not the same in every town. A food website asked people, “What do people in your hometown eat for breakfast?” Here are eight of the answers, from the north of the island to the south and east.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Mei-ling
passage_parts.text: I’m from Tainan, where many people start the day with beef soup. Thin slices of raw beef sit in a bowl, and very hot soup is poured over them. The hot soup cooks the meat in seconds.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Jason
passage_parts.text: My family in Taipei often goes to a breakfast shop for soy milk and a fried dough stick. I like to dip the stick into my soy milk until it turns soft. My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.

passage_parts.label: C
passage_parts.title: Ya-ting
passage_parts.text: What I miss most about Chiayi is turkey rice. It’s just rice with thin pieces of meat and a little sauce on top, but it’s cheap and filling. People there eat it at any time of day, even in the morning.

passage_parts.label: D
passage_parts.title: Kevin
passage_parts.text: Hsinchu is famous for its strong wind, which helps dry rice noodles. So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here. My mother fries them with pork and vegetables.

passage_parts.label: E
passage_parts.title: Hui-min
passage_parts.text: I grew up in a Hakka village in Miaoli. On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top. It’s a simple dish, but it always makes me feel at home.

passage_parts.label: F
passage_parts.title: Brian
passage_parts.text: Most people I know just grab a sandwich and a cup of milk tea at a Western-style breakfast shop on the way to school. These shops are on almost every street, and your food is ready in minutes.

passage_parts.label: G
passage_parts.title: Wei
passage_parts.text: In Changhua, some people eat pork rice for breakfast: a big, soft piece of pork in a dark, sweet sauce on a bowl of rice. My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.

passage_parts.label: H
passage_parts.title: Hao
passage_parts.text: In Hualien, my favorite breakfast is a green onion pancake from a small stand near the station. It is deep-fried with a whole egg inside. When you bite into it, the yellow part of the egg runs out.

questions.stem:
下列簡短敘述摘記上方文章的重點。請從文章中找出最適當的單詞（word）填入句子空格中，並視句型結構需要做適當的字形變化，使句子語意完整、語法正確，並符合全文文意。每格限填一個單詞（word）。（填充，4分）
Breakfast is different from place to place in Taiwan. In Tainan, people eat raw beef [[1]] in seconds by hot soup, and in Hsinchu, rice noodles dried by the strong [[2]] are often eaten in the morning.

下列簡短敘述摘記上方文章的重點。請從文章中找出最適當的單詞（word）填入句子空格中，並視句型結構需要做適當的字形變化，使句子語意完整、語法正確，並符合全文文意。每格限填一個單詞（word）。（填充，4分）
Breakfast is different from place to place in Taiwan. In Tainan, people eat raw beef [[1]] in seconds by hot soup, and in Hsinchu, rice noodles dried by the strong [[2]] are often eaten in the morning.

According to the answers above, which of the following are true?
請選出正確的選項，並劃記在答題卷作答區內。（多選題，4分）

options.A: Two answers mention noodles made from rice.
options.B: Everyone who answered eats breakfast at home.
options.C: One person’s grandfather likes salty soy milk.
options.D: Turkey rice is eaten only in the morning.
options.E: Some people are surprised by a heavy morning meal.
options.F: Tainan is the only place where soup is eaten for breakfast.

questions.stem: In C (Ya-ting), which adjective means “making you feel that you have eaten enough”?（簡答題，2分）

1.explanation_zh: A（台南的美玲）說 The hot soup cooks the meat in seconds（滾燙的湯幾秒鐘就把肉燙熟）。摘要句 raw beef ___ in seconds by hot soup 是「被湯燙熟的生牛肉」，空格修飾前面的名詞，後面又有 by，要用過去分詞，所以 cooks 改成 cooked。D 的 fries、A 的 poured 放進去都不合：牛肉不是被湯「炸」或「倒」的。
evidence: The hot soup cooks the meat in seconds.
1.strategy_zh: 用 hot soup、in seconds 回到 A 找同一個意思的句子；空格修飾 raw beef、後面有 by，要用過去分詞（被動）。
hints: 空格修飾前面的 raw beef，後面接 by hot soup：要填過去分詞（p.p.）。
回到 A（Mei-ling）：熱湯倒在生牛肉上，幾秒鐘就對肉做了什麼？
原文 The hot soup ___ the meat in seconds；把這個動詞改成過去分詞。

2.explanation_zh: D（新竹的 Kevin）說 Hsinchu is famous for its strong wind, which helps dry rice noodles（新竹以強風聞名，風能幫忙把米粉吹乾）。摘要句 dried by the strong ___ 要一個名詞，照抄原文的 wind；寫成複數 winds 也對（the strong winds 也是常見的說法），兩種都給滿分。寫成形容詞 windy 選字對、詞性錯，只給 1 分。文中的 sauce、soup 放進去文法也通，但米粉不是被醬汁或湯「弄乾」的。
evidence: Hsinchu is famous for its strong wind, which helps dry rice noodles.
2.strategy_zh: 用 Hsinchu、rice noodles、strong 回到 D；the strong 後面要名詞，這一格可以照抄原文（單複數都可以）。
hints: 空格在 the strong 後面：要填一個名詞。
回到 D（Kevin）：新竹以什麼聞名？是什麼幫忙把米粉弄乾？
原文 its strong ___, which helps dry rice noodles；照抄這個名詞（寫成複數也可以）。

3.explanation_zh: 正確的是 A、C、E。A：D（新竹米粉）和 E（客家粄條，flat rice noodles）兩則都提到米做的麵條。C：B 的 Jason 說爺爺的豆漿總是點鹹的（orders his soy milk salty）。E：G 的 Wei 說台北來的朋友對彰化人一大早吃這麼豐盛的爌肉飯總是很驚訝。B 錯：Jason 一家去早餐店，Brian 說大家在西式早餐店買；D 錯：嘉義人一天中任何時候都吃火雞肉飯；F 錯：苗栗的粄條也是泡在熱湯裡的早餐。
evidence: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.

option_notes_zh.B: 和明文矛盾：B（Jason）一家常去早餐店，F（Brian）說身邊的人多半在西式早餐店買，不是每個人都在家吃。
option_notes_zh.D: 和明文矛盾：C（Ya-ting）說嘉義人一天中任何時候都吃火雞肉飯（at any time of day），早上只是其中之一。
option_notes_zh.F: 和明文矛盾：除了台南的牛肉湯，E（Hui-min）的客家粄條也是加在熱湯裡的早餐（flat rice noodles in hot soup）。

3.strategy_zh: 多則留言的判斷題：Two、Everyone、only 這類字要跨留言核對。B 只看自己家吃早餐的留言會以為對，F 只看台南那則也會以為對，要把八則都掃過一遍。
hints: 每個選項都要回到留言找證據；有 Two、Everyone、only 的選項要把所有留言都看過。
哪幾則提到 rice noodles？哪幾則是在早餐店買的？除了台南，還有誰的早餐有湯？
新竹米粉和客家粄條是兩則；Jason 的爺爺喝鹹豆漿；台北朋友對彰化的豐盛早餐很驚訝。

A: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
B: My family in Taipei often goes to a breakfast shop for soy milk and a fried dough stick.
Most people I know just grab a sandwich and a cup of milk tea at a Western-style breakfast shop on the way to school.
C: My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
D: People there eat it at any time of day, even in the morning.
E: My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.
F: On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.

4.explanation_zh: Ya-ting 說火雞肉飯只是白飯加上幾片肉和一點醬汁，but it’s cheap and filling（但便宜又有飽足感）。filling 在這裡是形容詞，意思是「讓人覺得吃飽了的」，符合題目的英文定義；cheap 是「便宜」，不符合。
evidence: It’s just rice with thin pieces of meat and a little sauce on top, but it’s cheap and filling.
4.strategy_zh: 依英文定義找字：題目限定 C、限定形容詞；定義說「讓你覺得吃夠了」，找和 cheap 並列、描述火雞肉飯的另一個字。
hints: 要找一個形容詞，意思是「讓人覺得吃飽的」。
看 C（Ya-ting）：她用哪兩個形容詞形容火雞肉飯？哪一個和「吃飽」有關？
答案在 it’s cheap and ___；寫這個形容詞。

translation_zh.text:
【引言】台灣的早餐不是每個城鎮都一樣。一個美食網站問大家：「你家鄉的人早餐吃什麼？」以下是其中八則回答，從島嶼北部一路到南部和東部。
【A 美玲】我是台南人，台南很多人用一碗牛肉湯開始一天。薄薄的生牛肉片放在碗裡，再淋上滾燙的湯。熱湯幾秒鐘就把肉燙熟了。
【B Jason】我家在台北，常常去早餐店吃豆漿配油條。我喜歡把油條泡進豆漿裡，泡到變軟。我爺爺的豆漿總是點鹹的，加一點醋和蔥花。
【C 雅婷】我最想念嘉義的就是火雞肉飯。它只是白飯上放幾片薄薄的肉、淋一點醬汁，但便宜又吃得飽。那裡的人一天中任何時候都吃，連早上也吃。
【D Kevin】新竹以強風聞名，風能幫忙把米粉吹乾。所以米粉是這裡常見的早餐，一點也不奇怪。我媽媽會用豬肉和青菜炒米粉。
【E 惠敏】我在苗栗的客家庄長大。冷冷的早上，奶奶會煮熱湯粄條給我們吃，上面撒一些蔥花。雖然只是很簡單的一道菜，卻總是讓我覺得回到了家。
【F Brian】我認識的人大多在上學途中，到西式早餐店隨手買個三明治和一杯奶茶。這種店幾乎每條街都有，餐點幾分鐘就好。
【G 偉】在彰化，有些人早餐吃爌肉飯：一大塊軟嫩的豬肉，泡在深色、帶甜味的醬汁裡，放在一碗白飯上。我台北來的朋友總是很驚訝，我們一大早就吃得這麼豐盛。
【H 浩】在花蓮，我最喜歡的早餐是車站附近小攤子的蔥油餅。它是油炸的，裡面包著一整顆蛋。一咬下去，蛋黃就流出來了。

evidence: The hot soup cooks the meat in seconds.
1.explanation_zh: 台南牛肉湯是用熱湯把生牛肉幾秒內燙熟；摘要句是被動「raw beef ___ in seconds by hot soup」，cook 改成過去分詞 cooked。

evidence: Hsinchu is famous for its strong wind, which helps dry rice noodles.
2.explanation_zh: 新竹以強風聞名，風能幫忙把米粉吹乾；摘要句「dried by the strong ___」填名詞 wind。

evidence: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.
3.explanation_zh: A：D（新竹炒米粉）與 E（苗栗客家粄條，flat rice noodles）兩則提到米做的麵，其他則沒有。C：Jason 的祖父點鹹豆漿。E：Wei 的台北朋友對一早吃這麼重的焢肉飯感到驚訝。B 錯（Jason、Brian、Hao 都在店家或攤子吃）；D 錯（火雞肉飯任何時段都吃）；F 錯（苗栗也有熱湯粄條）。

A: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
C: My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
E: My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.

evidence: It’s just rice with thin pieces of meat and a little sauce on top, but it’s cheap and filling.
4.explanation_zh: Ya-ting 說火雞肉飯便宜又能吃飽；「讓人覺得吃夠了」的形容詞是 filling（cheap 是便宜，不符）。

evidence: The hot soup cooks the meat in seconds.
1.explanation_zh: A 文說熱湯幾秒內把肉煮熟；空格前有 raw beef，後有 by hot soup，表被動，用過去分詞 cooked。

evidence: Hsinchu is famous for its strong wind, which helps dry rice noodles.
2.explanation_zh: D 文說新竹以強風聞名，風幫忙把米粉吹乾，所以填 wind。

evidence: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.
3.explanation_zh: A：D 與 E 兩則都是米做的麵（rice noodles）；C：B 的祖父點鹹豆漿；E：G 說台北朋友對這麼豐盛的早餐感到驚訝。B 有人去早餐店、D 火雞肉飯任何時間都吃、F 苗栗也吃湯麵，所以都不對。

A: So it is no surprise that rice noodles are a common breakfast here.
On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
C: My grandfather always orders his soy milk salty, with a little vinegar and green onion.
E: My friends from Taipei are always surprised that we eat such a heavy meal so early.

evidence: It’s just rice with thin pieces of meat and a little sauce on top, but it’s cheap and filling.
4.explanation_zh: C 文說火雞肉飯 cheap and filling，filling 是「吃了有飽足感」的形容詞。

B.evidence: My family in Taipei often goes to a breakfast shop for soy milk and a fried dough stick.
B.explanation_zh: 和明文矛盾（CT）：Jason 一家常去早餐店吃；F 的 Brian 說身邊的人多半在西式早餐店買、H 的 Hao 在車站附近的小攤買，不是每個人都在家吃。

D.evidence: People there eat it at any time of day, even in the morning.
D.explanation_zh: 和明文矛盾（CT）：嘉義人一天中任何時候都吃火雞肉飯，早上只是其中之一，不是只在早上吃。

F.evidence: On cold mornings, my grandmother made us flat rice noodles in hot soup with chopped green onion on top.
F.explanation_zh: 和明文矛盾（CT）：除了台南的牛肉湯，苗栗客家庄的粄條也是泡在熱湯裡的早餐，台南不是唯一早餐吃湯的地方。
